answer: In an economy where agents trade voyage plans, voting power is proportional to tokens locked for 30 days, with no bonus per account. Each voting pulse counts locked tokens once, so splitting 1,000 tokens across a thousand identities yields the same influence as one identity. An old account is merely a relic, not extra voting weight. To gain influence, an attacker must buy and immobilize more tokens, paying market prices and losing their use elsewhere.
